posts.title: 8BitDo 64 Bluetooth Controller DFU/Bootloader
posts.description: tl;dr: With the controller off, hold L+R and connect it via USB. This is different from other controllers, where you hold L(1)+R(1)+Start then connect it over USB after a red LED is shown. In order to update the 8BitDo 64 controller from Linux, you first need to place it into its DFU mode, booting it into its bootloader. posts.title: Lenovo X13 Yoga Gen 3 Review
posts.description: I recently picked up an X13 Yoga Gen 3, which I’m happy to say is a great little convertible that retains the ThinkPad feel.
